final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback.

- **Dora:** Her site only showed a short intro and her email, dora@gmail.com. I used that address to invite her to Slack, then messaged her. I said the site is clean and simple and that her contact email is easy to find. I suggested adding more about her background, projects and interests, plus some visuals.
- **Eve:** Her blog only showed a short intro saying hiking is her favorite hobby. I messaged her that the personal touch makes it friendly. I suggested adding blog posts, such as hiking stories, trail recommendations and photos.
